info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Connect Actions List Views API
Salesforce Experience Cloud Get List View Data

params.name: listViewId
params.description: The ID of the list view

params.name: fields
params.description: Additional fields to include in list view records

params.name: optionalFields
params.description: Optional fields to include if accessible

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token for the next page of records

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field API name to sort by

items.docs: Returns the records and metadata for a specific list view including columns, sorting, filtering, and the record data. Used to render list views in custom UIs.

info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get List Views for Object

params.name: objectApiName
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce object (e.g., Account, Contact)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of list views per page

params.name: q
params.description: Search term to filter list views by name

items.docs: Returns all available list views for the specified object type. Includes list view ID, label, and developer name.
